The Fight for Justice'' |author=[[John Peel]] |cover artist=[[Maren]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[July]] [[1998]]''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]'' |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=128 |isbn=0590511688 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]–[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=''[[Star Wars Journal]]'' |preceded by=[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil|''Captive to Evil'']] |followed by=[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire|''Hero for Hire'']] }} '''''Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] junior novel written by [[John Peel]]. It is part of the ''[[Star Wars Journal]]s'' series, and it was published by [[Scholastic]] in [[July]] [[1998]], in conjunction with ''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]''. ''The Fight for Justice'' is presented as a group of [[in-universe]] [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] entries recorded by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]–[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
